title: Cake Stack
tagline: Stack yummy cake layers into a giant birthday cake for your animal friends!
howToPlay: A cake layer slides back and forth: tap, click or press Space to drop it on the cake. Line it up for a Perfect sparkle, and a wobbly drop just squishes a little. Stack all the layers (or tap the candle button when you are done) and an animal friend comes for a birthday party: tap to help blow out the candles! Every new friend brings a new flavour. Open Recipe studio to build pictured flavour recipes from bottom to top and share equal slices fairly among two or three friends.
learning: Counting, ordered recipes and equal sharing
